description: Catalogue Linux identity, accounts, sessions, authentication, histories, persistence, packages, SSH, journals/syslog, web and container logs through dissect.target. This reads Linux roots inside LVM and common VM disk containers without mounting them.
object: Linux disk image or extracted root
covers: Records exposed by the selected dissect.target Linux plugins. It does not carve deleted/unallocated data, parse arbitrary application data, acquire memory, unlock encrypted volumes without a key, or prove that an empty parser result means the artefact never existed.
